summary.title: Performance Insights: Q1 Financial Analysis
summary.text:
The Q1 financial performance analysis reveals a total gross revenue of $25,641,503.32, with an average order value of $138.59. This suggests a steady customer spending pattern and a well-performing sales strategy.

The cost structure indicates a total cost of goods sold at $7,159,128.86, equating to an average cost per unit of $38.70. The high cost per unit could be a potential area for optimization in the production process. Additionally, the top drivers contributing to the revenue are 'Silver' (33,546,761,911.0), 'Gold' (31,973,711,570.0), and 'SILVER' (843,754,821.0). These findings suggest a significant contribution from precious metals to the overall revenue.

kpis.label: RECEIVABLES OUTSTANDING
kpis.subtitle: Modelled from annual credit sales
kpis.definition: The total gross balance of open, unpaid customer invoices currently owed to the company.

kpis.label: DAYS SALES OUTSTANDING (DSO)
kpis.subtitle: Current baseline collection cycle
kpis.definition: The average number of days required to collect cash payment from customers after a credit sale has been completed.

kpis.label: BEST POSSIBLE DSO (BPDSO)
kpis.subtitle: Zero overdue optimal benchmark
kpis.definition: The lowest achievable DSO assuming all customers strictly adhere to credit terms and zero invoices become overdue.

kpis.label: TARGET DSO
kpis.subtitle: 8 days of DSO reduction target
kpis.definition: The strategic collection benchmark targeted through improved dispute resolution and dunning workflows.

kpis.label: ONE-OFF CASH RELEASE
kpis.subtitle: Liquidity unlocked at target DSO
kpis.definition: The one-time liquidity released and injected back into operating cash flow by reducing DSO to the target level.

kpis.label: ANNUAL SAVINGS RUN RATE
kpis.subtitle: Bad debt, financing & recovery savings
kpis.definition: The recurring annual financial savings generated from financing interest avoided, bad-debt reduction, and lower collection overhead.

kpis.label: COLLECTION EFFECTIVENESS (CEI)
kpis.subtitle: Overall cash collection performance
kpis.definition: Measures collection performance and quality within a given time frame (values closer to 100% indicate peak collection efficacy).

kpis.label: EXPECTED CREDIT LOSS (ECL)
kpis.subtitle: Flagged high-risk account exposure
kpis.definition: The statistically estimated impairment loss across outstanding accounts based on default probabilities and risk profiles.

kpis.label: OVER-LIMIT ORDERS BLOCKED
kpis.subtitle: Credit-breach orders held in queue
kpis.definition: Total monetary value of customer purchase orders currently held by the system due to credit limit breaches.

kpis.label: INVOICES RECONCILED COUNT
kpis.subtitle: Straight-through touchless matching
kpis.definition: Total count and volume of invoices matched and reconciled straight-through without manual human escalation.

kpis.label: YEAR-ONE RETURN (ROI)
kpis.subtitle: Net return multiple on investment
kpis.definition: The multiple of net financial return delivered in year one relative to the total software platform and setup investment.
